applicableAreas: Buildings 1, 6, 7, and 8 adjacent to existing overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Buildings 1 and 8 are positioned directly adjacent to the existing overhead electric line running along the western property boundary (Valley View Road), and Buildings 6 and 7 are adjacent to the eastern boundary overhead line, but the site plan does not show measured horizontal sky-to-ground clearance dimensions from the outside conductor to any building face. No clearance verification documents or building elevation sheets with surveyed conductor locations are provided.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1, 6, 7, 8 and parking areas adjacent to overhead distribution lines
findings.comment: The site plan shows existing overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors along the western and eastern property boundaries, with proposed buildings and facilities in close proximity, but does not provide 15-foot radial clearance dimension annotations from the outside conductor of the distribution lines to any customer facilities. No radial clearance verification is documented.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1 and 8 within potential clearance distance of Valley View Road right-of-way
findings.comment: Buildings 1 and 8 are proposed adjacent to the Valley View Road right-of-way where overhead electric facilities exist or may be relocated. Site plan does not document the permanent 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances required from the outside conductor to the building structures.

applicableAreas: All buildings within clearance distance of existing overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: No building elevation sheets are provided that show surveyed elevations and locations of overhead conductors relative to buildings, building projections, rooflines, and other site features. Vertical clearance verification requires registered surveyor documentation of pole locations and conductor elevations.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1, 6, 7, 8 and all structures within clearance distance of overhead lines
findings.comment: Section and plan view exhibits do not show dimensions from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of proposed buildings and building projections. Clearance verification requires dimensioned detail sections showing the spatial relationship between conductors and building elements.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls located throughout the site, particularly around pond area
findings.comment: Retaining walls are proposed around the perimeter and detention pond areas of the site where overhead electric lines exist on adjacent properties and easements. Dimension annotations do not establish that the retaining walls maintain the required 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from the outermost electric line.

applicableAreas: Retaining wall sections and profiles
findings.comment: Section views for retaining walls do not include dimension lines from the outer electric conductor to the outermost face of the wall for clearance verification. Profile cross-sections must show the vertical and horizontal relationship between overhead conductors and wall structures.

applicableAreas: Driveways on Valley View Road frontage and interior site driveways crossing under or adjacent to existing overhead lines
findings.comment: Grading plan shows driveway alignments and finished grades but does not provide vertical clearance dimensions to existing overhead electric lines. No mid-span clearance measurements from a registered surveyor are documented to verify that driveways will maintain minimum 16-foot (without trucks) or 18-foot (with truck traffic) vertical clearance from the lowest point of overhead facilities.

applicableAreas: Parking areas and vehicle storage pads
findings.comment: Site plan shows parking and vehicle areas but does not document vertical clearance from overhead electric lines or provide notes specifying the required clearance distances. Where parking occurs beneath or adjacent to existing overhead lines, vertical clearance dimensions and maintenance notes must be provided.

applicableAreas: All clearance dimensions shown on site plan sheets
findings.comment: Where any clearance dimensions are shown on the site plan, they do not explicitly identify whether measurement origins extend from the outside conductor itself or from the utility pole centerline. On multi-conductor installations, the outside conductor may be several feet offset from pole center, making accurate measurement from conductor essential for code compliance.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1, 6, 7, 8 and all site features adjacent to or beneath existing overhead distribution lines
findings.comment: The site plan shows proposed buildings and site improvements positioned immediately adjacent to and parallel with existing overhead electric distribution lines along the western (Valley View Road) and eastern property boundaries. UCM § 1.10.3 prohibits customer facilities from being installed under or over Austin Energy distribution facilities regardless of clearance distance. No documentation is provided indicating approval for proposed facilities to remain in these locations, coordination with Austin Energy regarding potential relocation of existing lines, or special clearance verification.

applicableAreas: Driveways, parking, and building locations adjacent to existing overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Vertical clearances from proposed site features to existing overhead electric lines appear marginal or insufficient based on site plan elevations and visible pole locations. No registered surveyor mid-span clearance data or pole location survey is provided to verify that required vertical clearances will be maintained.

applicableAreas: Trees proposed near southern property boundary and perimeter areas with existing overhead distribution and transmission facilities
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows trees proposed in close proximity to existing overhead electric lines, with some tree locations appearing to be within 10 feet of the distribution line conductors. Tree species are not verified against ECM Appendix F Utility Compatible list for species marked 'UC', and no lateral distance clearance dimensions or notes are provided documenting compliance with the required 10-foot clearance from distribution lines and 50-foot clearance from transmission lines.

applicableAreas: Construction staging areas, equipment laydown zones, and work platforms throughout the site
findings.comment: No construction logistics plan, site logistics plan, or construction phasing plan is provided showing construction staging areas, crane swing radius boundaries, material storage zones, or equipment operation areas with documented 10-foot radial clearance from existing energized overhead electric lines per OSHA and UCM § 1.10.2. This is a separate requirement from permanent facility clearances.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet and general notes for entire project
findings.comment: Site plans do not include the required note stating that the owner and contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines, as mandated by Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003. This note must appear on the cover sheet or general notes.

applicableAreas: Building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, decks, roofs, patios) on buildings adjacent to overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: No building elevation sheets or architectural drawings are provided showing the extent and location of building projections (overhangs, balconies, etc.) relative to existing overhead electric conductors. Verification of required 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances from building projections cannot be completed without architectural elevation details.

applicableAreas: Fences shown on site plan
findings.comment: While fences are depicted on the site plan, clearance dimension annotations from the fence alignment to the outside conductor of existing overhead electric facilities are not provided. Verification that fences maintain the required 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance cannot be completed.

applicableAreas: Fence post locations relative to existing utility poles
findings.comment: Utility pole locations are shown on the existing conditions survey and site plan, and fence alignments are shown on the site plan, but horizontal dimension annotations establishing that fence posts maintain the required 10-foot clearance from electric poles are not provided.

applicableAreas: Transmission easement boundaries and access gates
findings.comment: Transmission easement boundaries are referenced in the general notes (Sheet 3), but detail sheets showing specifications for any fencing within or adjacent to the transmission easement (non-conductive material or proper grounding) and gate locking mechanisms are not provided.

applicableAreas: Roads and driveways within or beneath transmission easement
findings.comment: Transmission structures and easement exist on the property with requirements documented on Sheet 3 (25-foot no-dig/no-plant zone), but the grading plan does not show vertical clearance dimensions confirming that final road/driveway grades maintain the required minimum 30-foot vertical clearance from electric transmission lines.

applicableAreas: Existing utility poles adjacent to proposed driveways on Valley View Road frontage
findings.comment: Existing utility poles are shown on both the existing conditions survey and site plan positioned immediately adjacent to proposed driveways on the western boundary. The site plan does not indicate whether these poles will be relocated at least 30 feet from the edge of the driveway or will remain in their current locations.

applicableAreas: Sidewalks along Valley View Road right-of-way frontage
findings.comment: New and modified sidewalks along the Valley View Road frontage are proposed where existing power poles are located at property ends. Clearance from sidewalk alignments to existing pole locations is not documented.

applicableAreas: Trash enclosure location
findings.comment: Site plan shows trash collection area designation but does not clearly establish the specific location relative to existing overhead electric facilities or document that minimum 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance is maintained when trash containers are raised during service.

applicableAreas: Proposed water meter location
findings.comment: Utility plan shows meter locations but does not document clearance from existing overhead electric service drops or provide dimension annotations showing 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from the outside conductor.

applicableAreas: Water line routing near overhead distribution facilities
findings.comment: Utility plan shows water line routing but does not provide clearance dimensions or verification documentation showing compliance with required clearances from overhead electrical distribution facilities.

applicableAreas: Building foundations within 5 feet of Valley View Road property line
findings.comment: Buildings are located near the western property line (Valley View Road) where utility easements exist for electric infrastructure in the right-of-way. Documentation is not provided establishing that foundation placement allows necessary clearance space for electric facility installation and maintenance.

applicableAreas: Decorative lighting fixture locations
findings.comment: Landscape plan indicates light fixtures but does not provide clearance dimension annotations or notes establishing that decorative lighting maintains required 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances if located beneath overhead electric lines.

applicableAreas: Proposed electric meter locations
findings.comment: Meter locations are shown on electrical plans but no detail enlargements or notes are provided documenting that proposed meter installations will not be obstructed by site features, structures, or landscaping, and that they will maintain required working clearances (30-inch-wide front space, 36-inch front depth, 6.5-foot headroom).

applicableAreas: Buildings and structures in proximity to existing streetlight poles
findings.comment: Existing streetlight poles are noted on the existing conditions survey, but site plan does not document clearances from proposed buildings and structures to these light pole locations.

applicableAreas: Down guy wires from distribution poles at western and eastern property boundaries
findings.comment: Existing conditions survey shows utility poles with guy wires at property boundaries. Site plan does not document whether down guy wire anchor points conflict with proposed accessible paths or driveways, and if conflicts exist, whether poles will be relocated or converted to self-supporting structures.

applicableAreas: Angled guy anchors from transmission structures
findings.comment: Transmission structures exist on the site per Sheet 3 notes and facts, but easement exhibit and site plan do not show dedicated guy easement boundaries with the required 10-foot width either side of guy wire alignment plus 50-foot extension beyond anchor point.

applicableAreas: Down guy anchor points from distribution poles at property boundaries
findings.comment: Distribution poles with guy anchors are shown on the existing conditions survey, but easement exhibit does not show dedicated down guy anchor easements with the required 10-foot width and minimum 5-foot extension past anchor ground entry point per Austin Energy standards.

applicableAreas: Pad-mounted transformers shown on electrical plan
findings.comment: Electrical plan shows transformer pad locations but does not provide section views or dimension annotations documenting minimum 7.5-foot vertical sky-to-ground clearance from the top of transformer equipment to existing overhead electric lines if lines exist above or adjacent to transformer locations.

applicableAreas: Service-mast installation if shown on building designs
findings.comment: If service-mast through-roof installations are proposed, building elevation sheets must be provided showing the mast location relative to roof edges and documenting either minimum 3-foot clearance above roof or 18-inch clearance if mast is within 4 feet of roof edge (for voltages ≤300V). No such elevations are provided in the submitted plans.
